_meta.description: This file contains a serialized version of schema entities for drift.

sql.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "food_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "meal" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "grams" REAL NULL, "serving_label" TEXT NULL, "serving_qty" REAL NULL, "energy_kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "carb_g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.0, "logged_via" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'search', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "profiles" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "dob" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "height_cm" REAL NOT NULL, "sex" TEXT NOT NULL, "activity" TEXT NOT NULL, "goal" TEXT NOT NULL, "diet" TEXT NOT NULL, "cuisine" TEXT NOT NULL, "conditions" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', "onboarding_complete" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("onboarding_complete" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "water_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "amount_ml" INTEGER NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "weight_logs" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "weight_kg" REAL NOT NULL, "note" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_plans" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "config" TEXT NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user_imported', "active" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("active" IN (0, 1)), "start_date" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "user_foods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "source_table" TEXT NULL, "source_id" TEXT NULL, "energy_kcal" REAL NULL, "protein_g" REAL NULL, "carb_g" REAL NULL, "fat_g" REAL NULL, "fiber_g" REAL NULL, "serving_label" TEXT NULL, "serving_grams" REAL NULL, "use_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "meals" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "items" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "default_meal" TEXT NULL, "use_count" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "workouts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'strength', "duration_min" INTEGER NULL, "energy_kcal" REAL NULL, "sets" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', "notes" TEXT NULL, "logged_via" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'manual', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "target_history" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "date" TEXT NOT NULL, "calories" INTEGER NOT NULL, "protein_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, "carb_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fat_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, "fiber_g" INTEGER NOT NULL, "water_ml" INTEGER NOT NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'computed', "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_threads" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "title" TEXT NOT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "summary" TEXT NULL, "summarized_up_to" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "chat_messages" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "thread_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "role" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "synthetic" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK ("synthetic" IN (0, 1)), "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "memory_facts" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "user_id" TEXT NULL, "kind" TEXT NOT NULL, "content" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0.5, "source_thread_id" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, "updated_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "foods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "name_hi" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "cuisine_region" TEXT NULL, "food_group" TEXT NULL, "energy_kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL, "carb_g" REAL NOT NULL, "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL, "fiber_g" REAL NULL, "default_serving_label" TEXT NULL, "default_serving_grams" REAL NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "licence" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" REAL NOT NULL, "source_ref" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "off_foods" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "name" TEXT NOT NULL, "barcode" TEXT NULL, "type" TEXT NOT NULL, "cuisine_region" TEXT NULL, "food_group" TEXT NULL, "energy_kcal" REAL NOT NULL, "protein_g" REAL NOT NULL, "carb_g" REAL NOT NULL, "fat_g" REAL NOT NULL, "fiber_g" REAL NULL, "default_serving_label" TEXT NULL, "default_serving_grams" REAL NULL, "source" TEXT NOT NULL, "licence" TEXT NOT NULL, "confidence" REAL NOT NULL, "source_ref" TEXT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "sync_failures" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "target_table" TEXT NOT NULL, "op" TEXT NOT NULL, "row_id" TEXT NOT NULL, "code" TEXT NULL, "message" TEXT NULL, "payload" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "pending_uploads" ("id" TEXT NOT NULL, "bucket" TEXT NOT NULL, "local_name" TEXT NOT NULL, "remote_path" TEXT NOT NULL, "attempts" INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, "last_error" TEXT NULL, "created_at" INTEGER NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY ("id"));
